The '''Khar Delba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> containing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khar Delba]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Khar Shian]].<ref name="Golden Age 3" />
